name: Ricochet Rumble
tagline: Dodge the shot you just fired.
description: Steer a numbered tank through a new maze each round. Hold Fire to send shells bouncing off walls, then move away: your own shots can hit you. Collect special weapons, survive five rounds, and win the most rounds.
howToPlay: Find your numbered tank. Hold forward or reverse to drive; hold left or right to turn.
Hold Fire. Shells bounce and can hit you. Drive over crates for special weapons.
Last tank earns a point; multiple survivors draw. Most points after five rounds wins.

settings.label: Weapon crates
settings.description: Collect Burst, Beam and Seeker weapons in the maze
